## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, unit tests, notices)

- [ ] User-visible changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Settings or commands that changed are updated in `package.json` and the README tables
